meta_description:
2,348 likes, 17 comments - financewithsharan on October 8, 2026: "Your biggest financial risk may not be losing 20% in the market. It could be having creditors come after your personal assets. 👀

This is why asset protection matters.

PF and PPF can have protections that investments like mutual funds may not have in certain situations. So if you run a business, have personally guaranteed large loans, or have significant debt exposure, where you keep your wealth matters.

The goal isn’t just to build wealth.
It’s to make sure you can protect enough of it to start again if things go wrong.

#FinanceWithSharan #AssetProtection #WealthProtection #PersonalFinance #PF".
